code: body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; box-shadow: inset 0 0 300px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.9); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: pulseCrisis 0.4s infinite alternate; } @keyframes pulseCrisis { from { opacity: 0.6; } to { opacity: 1; } } body, .chat-container, .message { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8); color: #ffe6e6; transition: all 0.2s ease; }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a001a 0%, #000000 100%); } #app-container { box-shadow: 0 0 30px #ff0055, 0 0 60px #8800ff; animation: plasmaPulse 2s infinite alternate; transition: all 0.5s ease-in-out; } @keyframes plasmaPulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px #ff0055, 0 0 60px #8800ff; border-color: #ff0055; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 50px #ff0055, 0 0 120px #ff00aa; border-color: #ff00aa; } } .message.ai { text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.5); }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a0000 0%, #000000 100%); animation: feralPlasmaPulse 1.5s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes feralPlasmaPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.7); } } .visualizer-container { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ff0000); }

body { animation: plasmaPulse 2s infinite alternate, feralShake 0.5s infinite; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a0000 0%, #000000 100%); } @keyframes plasmaPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px #ff0000; } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px #ff0044; } } @keyframes feralShake { 0% { transform: translate(0.5px, 0.5px) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translate(-0.5px, -0.5px) rotate(0.1deg); } 100% { transform: translate(0.5px, -0.5px) rotate(-0.1deg); } }
